name: Dersum (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, yellow and red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Dersum (a balance and a sheaf above a blue wavy bar and clover leaves on yellow).
history: The colours red and gold stand for the abbey of Corvey and the prince-bishopric of Münster, to which the municipal territory belonged.

features.role: Dersum arms — balance, sheaf and clover leaves
